# Remote address-book capture changed from inferred host to explicit server

The initial Account Hub remote form captures domain || explicitServer, so an inferred username domain wins. The checked fixed form instead captures explicitServer || domain || emptyString, and a later widget test directly asserts that an explicit different URL wins. Keep these source states separate. The completion predicate still accepts a nonempty inferred domain without calling server.checkValidity, so captured-value precedence and local completeness are different checks. Review questioned deeper parsing; the author reported equivalence with the existing flow, without proving a strict parser. The original parent forward branch is empty, while selected fixed code later normalizes a host to HTTPS and enters a separate credential/discovery route. Input-state tests and a design approval do not establish server authentication or successful remote-book creation. No runtime test ran.

Scope: Account Hub remote address-book input capture.
